spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (वर्हति) also (इ) वृहि (वृंहति)
1 To grow or increase.
2 (In the second form only,) To roar, as a wild beast.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (वृहति वृहयति)
1 To speak.
2 To shine.
(ऊ) वृहू r. 6th cl. (वृहति)
To make any effort or exertion.

m. (-त्तः)
A citron.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Large bodied, gigantic.
E.
वृहत्, and शरीर body.

m. (-ल्कः)
A prawn.
E.
वृहत् great, and शल्क scale.

m. (-नः)
A great or illustrious man.
E.
वृहत्, and जन a person.

f. (-क्का)
A large drum.
E.
वृहत् large, ढक्का a drum.

mfn. (-हन्-हती-हत)
1 Great, large.
2 Great, much.
f. (-हती)
1 A small kind of egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)
2 A kind of prickly nightshade, (Solanum hirsutum.)
3 A large lute.
4 A form of metre, the stanza of which consists of thirtysix syllables.
5 A mantle, a wrapper.
6 A reservoir, a place containing water.
7 Speech.
E.
वृह to grow or increase, Uṇādi aff. अति, with the effect of the participial aff. शतृ.

f. (-का)
1 An upper garment, a mantle, a wrapper.
2 A small sort of egg-plant.
E.
वृहती as above, कन् added, fem. form.

m. (-तिः)
VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods.
E.
वृहति speech, eloquence, and पति lord.

mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं)
Large, great.
E.
वृहत् the same, and कन् added.

m. (-न्दः)
A bulbous root, considered in some places as a large kind of onion, in others as a sort of garlick.
E.
वृहत्, large, and कन्द a root.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Large bodied, bulky, gigantic.
E.
वृहत्, and काय body.

m. (-कः)
A shrub, (Cassia purpurea, or a large variety of it.)
E.
वृहत् large, and कालशाक the same.

n. (-शं)
A large kind of the grass Kāś, (Saccharum spontaneum).
E.
वृहत् large, काश the same grass.

mfn. (-क्षिः-क्षिः or क्षी-क्षि)
Corpulent, large or pot-bellied.
E.
वृहत् large, कुक्षि the belly.

m. (-णः)
The bambu.
E.
वृहत् large, and तृण grass.

m. (-त्त्वक्)
A plant, (Echites scholaris.)
E.
वृहत् large, and त्वच् skin or bark.

f. (-लिः)
Thorn-apple, (Datura metel.)
E.
वृहत् large, पाटलि the Bignonia.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
Large footed.
m. (-दः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
वृहत् large, and पाद foot or root.

mfn. (-ष्पः-ष्पा-ष्पं)
Having large flowers.
f. (-ष्पी)
Crotolaria of various species.
E.
वृहत् large, and पुष्प a flower.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Large bodied, bulky.
2 Large limbed.
3 Having many parts.
m. (-ङ्गः)
A large elephant, such a one as is usually the leader of a wild herd.
E.
वृहत् large, and अङ्ग body.

m. (-म्लः)
A fruit tree, (Averrhoa carambola.)
E.
वृहत् large or much, and अम्ल sour.

m. (-तिः)
An evil spirit, a goblin.
E.
वृहत् large, असृक् blood, and मति inclination.

m. (-हः)
A country, described as lying behind the Vindhya mountains, near the province of Malva, and perhaps comprising Bundelkhand, or the adjoining district.
E.
वृहत् large, and गृह a house; also read वृहद्गुह from गुह a cave, the country being mountainous, and the people probably having been Troglodytes or dwellers in caves.

n. (-लं)
A water-melon.
E.
वृहत् large, and गोल round, or a ball.

f. (-तिः)
Radiance, splendor, a great light.
E.
वृहत्, and द्युति light.

n. (-लं)
The furrow made by a plough.
E.
वृहत् large, हल a plough.

f. (-का)
A name of UMĀ or DURGĀ.
E.
वृहत् great, and भद्दारिका princess.

m. (-नुः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
वृहत् large, many, and भानु a ray of light.

INDRA.
2

A sacrificial vessel.
3 A particular

Mantra.
4

A division of the Sāma Veda.
f. (-थी)
The name of a river.
E.
वृहत् large, and रथ a car.

f. (-वी)
A small owl.
E.
वृहत् great, much, राव cry, ङीष् aff.

m. (-तः)
A grain, generally eaten by the natives of India, (Andropogon sorghum.)
E.
वृहत् much, and वात wind, supposed to generate this humour.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Having much or large seed.
m. (-जः)
The hog-plum, (Spondias mangifera.)
E.
वृहत् large, and वीज seed.

m. (-लः)
1 A large sort of reed, (Arundo gigantea.)
2

ARJUNA.
3

The arm.
E.
वृहत् large, and नल a reed.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Large, bulky, protuberant.
E.
वृहत्, and निषेश place.

m. (-तिः)
The regent of the planet JUPITER, identified astronomically with the planet; in Mythology, he is the son of AṄGIRAS, and preceptor of the gods.
2 The name of a saint and law-giver.
E.
वृहत् great, illustrious, (as the deities,) and पति master or Guru, सुट् augment, and the final of the first member rejected; it also occasionally occurs वृहतांपति.

n. (-क्रं)
The cycle of 60 years.
E.
वृहस्पति, and चक्र a cycle.
